breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two conflicting time integration methods: 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Crank–Nicolson'. The agent correctly identified this conflict and, in alignment with the ground truth, selected 'Crank–Nicolson' as the sole method for the final specification, completely omitting the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction.
